blocked.needs_vault: Choose a notes folder to get started — it's the only required step.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.body: Translation, voice input, transcription and notes in one workspace. Start with your language and look.

local.title: Your data stays local
local.desc: Notes are saved as Markdown and recordings as audio files, in a folder on this Mac.

compute.title: Compute is your choice
compute.desc: Run AI on this device, or use Lunarca Cloud or your organization's server. No sign-in required.

network.title: You control network access
network.desc: Network use is always shown and can be turned off. Switch to strict local any time.

vault.title: Choose a notes folder
vault.body: Your notes will be saved in this folder.
vault.path_placeholder: Enter an absolute local folder path…
vault.onedrive_moved_hint: Your Documents folder is synced by OneDrive, so the notes folder goes here by default: inside Documents, OneDrive and Lunarca sync would both change the same files and create conflict copies.
vault.onedrive_inside_hint: This location is inside a folder synced by OneDrive: OneDrive and Lunarca sync may both change the same files and create conflict copies. You can still use it.

compute.title: Sign in (optional)
compute.body: The server you sign in to provides AI and sync. Without signing in, everything on this device still works.
compute.skip_hint: To use only this device, just choose Continue. You can sign in any time under Settings › Account.

models.title: Prepare models
models.body: A transcription model ships with Lunarca and works out of the box. What else you need depends on your last choice.
models.hardware_error: Hardware check failed; recommending the standard tier.
models.low_hint: This device has options: a smaller model, or the server you picked in the previous step.
models.bundled_ready: The bundled model is ready — transcribe without downloading anything.
models.fallback_not_ready: The local standby is not ready yet: transcription will be unavailable whenever the server cannot be reached.
models.fallback_hint: Only used when your server can't be reached; skipping it now won't stop you from getting started.
models.offline: Offline right now — download once you're connected
models.later_hint: You can download it later in Settings › Local models.
models.later_hint_downloading: The download continues in the background — you can move on.
models.llm_detected: {{count}} text model(s) already installed on this device and ready to use.
models.llm_none: No local text model yet — download the recommended one to polish and translate text on this device.
models.error: Failed to read the model list

permissions.title: System permissions
permissions.body: You can grant permissions the first time a feature needs them.

microphone.name: Microphone
microphone.purpose: Voice input and meeting recording need to capture audio; without it those features are unavailable.
microphone.later: You can wait: the system asks again the first time you start voice input.

accessibility.name: Accessibility
accessibility.purpose: Popup translation's double-copy and "replace original" need to observe shortcuts and write text back at the cursor; without it, use the fallback hotkey and paste manually.
accessibility.later: Tick Lunarca under System Settings › Privacy & Security › Accessibility; the status refreshes when you switch back.

notification.name: Notifications
notification.purpose: Get notified when long background tasks (transcription, model downloads) finish; declining doesn't block anything — in-app notices are used instead.
notification.later: macOS does not expose this permission's state. After the first notification, find Lunarca under System Settings › Notifications; turning it off falls back to in-app messages.

permissions.skip_hint: All of these can be skipped — the feature will guide you again the first time it needs them.
permissions.none_required: No extra permissions are needed on this platform — voice input, popup translation and notifications work out of the box.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.body: These shortcuts work in any app.

first_task.title: First task
first_task.body: Try one and see it work. This step ticks itself once you succeed.
first_task.voice_desc: Press {{shortcut}} to open the voice panel; speak and it becomes text.
first_task.voice_desc_unbound: Open the voice panel; speak and it becomes text.
first_task.voice_not_ready: The transcription model isn't ready yet, so voice input can't run.
first_task.mic_denied: Microphone access is denied, so voice input can't run.
first_task.translate_desc: Select text and press {{shortcut}} to translate. A sample sentence is filled in — click Translate.
first_task.translate_desc_unbound: Open the translation popup; a sample sentence is already filled in — click Translate to see the result.
first_task.translate_not_ready: The text model isn't ready yet, so translation can't run.
first_task.clip_desc: No microphone, no download. A short English clip that ships with Lunarca, transcribed in seconds — your first note.
first_task.clip_not_ready: The transcription model is not ready yet, so the sample cannot run.
first_task.clip_queued: Queued — this step ticks itself once transcription finishes.
first_task.none_ready_hint: Both still need a model. Go back and set one up, or enter the app now.
first_task.sample_text: Lunarca 把笔记留在这台设备上，并让你决定 AI 在哪里运行。
first_task.panel_hint: Panels float above your current app without interrupting it.
first_task.success_body: Notes and recordings are saved in the folder you just picked; notes are Markdown, so other editors can open them.
first_task.remaining_hint: Still open: {{items}}. A bar stays at the top of the app so you can come back any time.
first_task.all_done_hint: All done. You can re-run this guide from Settings › General.
